heading: Interest on State and local bonds

tree.heading: Exclusion
tree.text: Except as provided in subsection (b), gross income does not include interest on any State or local bond.

children.heading: Private activity bond which is not a qualified bond
children.text: Any private activity bond which is not a qualified bond (within the meaning of section 141).

children.heading: Arbitrage bond
children.text: Any arbitrage bond (within the meaning of section 148).

children.heading: Bond not in registered form, etc.
children.text: Any bond unless such bond meets the applicable requirements of section 149.

tree.heading: Definitions
tree.text: For purposes of this section and part IV—

children.heading: State or local bond
children.text: The term “State or local bond” means an obligation of a State or political subdivision thereof.

children.heading: State
children.text: The term “State” includes the District of Columbia and any possession of the United States.
